app_description: Transcribe audio and video files entirely on your device — no uploads, no cloud.
app_bullet_private: Private by design: your files never leave your device.
app_bullet_download: Models are downloaded on first use — the app automatically picks the best fit for your device. More powerful devices download larger, more accurate models (up to ~5 GB total); less powerful devices get smaller, faster ones (~500 MB). A WiFi connection is recommended.
app_bullet_performance: Performance depends on your device: the app will automatically try lighter models if needed, but older or low-memory devices may have limitations.
app_bullet_accuracy: AI models are not perfect: transcriptions and extracted events may contain mistakes. Larger models tend to be more accurate, but require more resources and can still make errors.
reset_model_label: Reset which model the app will try to load on next startup.
wifi_warning_body: It looks like you are on a mobile connection. This app needs to download large files (up to ~5 GB) the first time it runs. We strongly recommend connecting to WiFi before continuing.
offline_ready: I downloaded all I needed — feel free to go offline.
switching_model: Switching to a smaller model ({{model}}), please wait...
no_model_error: Unfortunately, there's no transcription model that can be loaded on this device, as it is memory constrained.
file_label: Please select the file to transcribe
webgpu_notice: Good news — transcription will use your GPU for better performance.
wasm_notice: Transcription might take a while on this device. Task extraction with AI is not available without WebGPU.
kofi_link: ☕ If you find this useful, consider buying me a coffee
extract_tasks_btn: Extract tasks and events with AI →
add_to_calendar_warning: ⚠ Add to calendar — date needs review
